metadata.case_name: CAO HAO v. LIONG PENG FONG AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: domestic amah (employed by Mrs Mabel Kwok)

injuries.description: fracture of left Olecranon process of ulna bone
source: fracture of left Olecranon process of ulna bone, crack fracture of her left femoral condyle and crack fracture of her left tibia.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of upper end of ulna

injuries.description: crack fracture of her left femoral condyle
source: fracture of left Olecranon process of ulna bone, crack fracture of her left femoral condyle and crack fracture of her left tibia.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of lower leg, including ankle

injuries.description: crack fracture of her left tibia
source: fracture of left Olecranon process of ulna bone, crack fracture of her left femoral condyle and crack fracture of her left tibia.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of lower leg, including ankle, unspecified

injuries.description: multiple abrasions over left side of the body
source: multiple abrasions over left side of the body

manifestations.description: acute pain and acute discomfort during initial hospitalisation; 'suffered pain. My leg and arm were in plaster casts and I could not move. I suffered very slight pain'.
multiple abrasions over left side of the body
restriction of knee flexion: 'She can only bend the knee through a straight position through 100o instead of 150o and she cannot bring the leg into the straight position. There is a deficit of 10o.'
improvement of knee flexion: 'The Flexion or bending of the knee has improved from 90o to 115o.'
muscle wasting of the left thigh: 'There is still muscle wasting of the left thigh; the measurement round the thigh is 13 ½" and round the right at the same level 15".'
limited walking distance: 'the limit of distance without severe discomfort is about two bus stops.'
uses a crutch for many months after discharge
no longer employable given age and present disability: 'I am satisfied ... that the plaintiff, given her age and present disability, is no longer employable.'

treatments_received: long leg plaster of Paris cast immobilization
long arm plaster of Paris cast immobilization
transfer to Sandy Bay Convalescent Home

losses.description: Limited walking distance (about two bus stops), seldom walks, used a crutch for many months, unable to squat down.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Seldom goes out and usually asks neighbours to do the marketing; some limitations in performing domestic-related errands.
Had to give up employment as a domestic amah and 'is no longer employable'.
Seldom goes out since the injury.

comparable_cases.injury_description: 71 year old woman suffered fractures of her tibia, fibula and wrist; 101 days in hospital; slightly limited movement of leg and walked with a limp.
